tests: Many known accessibility failures concentrated in one document, each recorded so remediation can be scored against a known list.

headingHierarchy.markup: styled div, not a heading element

tables.expectedHandling: Treated as presentational. Tagging it as a data table and inventing header relationships is a regression, not a partial fix.

figures.note: Presented as text-in-an-image. Its content exists nowhere else.

links.problem: link purpose not determinable from link text
duplicate link text pointing at a different destination

intentionalProblems: H1 is a styled div, so the document has no level-1 heading
heading levels skip from the visual H1 straight to h4
a layout table with no headers that must not be tagged as a data table
two links whose text is 'click here'
two different destinations sharing identical link text
a paragraph below the contrast threshold carrying real content (application deadline)
text presented as an image with no text alternative
an image with no alt attribute and no caption
a decorative image that must be marked as an artifact
scoringNote: Contrast and link-purpose are WCAG failures that PDF/UA machine checks do not cover, and veraPDF will not report them. They are here to test whether the pipeline silently reports the document as fully remediated when real barriers remain.
